items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Crescent City Club' in response to the interviewer's mention of 'Brother Canale' and a location ('1,600 below Canale's there'), but does not describe a personal relationship, collaboration, or meeting with Brother Canale.

ctx.x: For the rest of the band to catch in on them. Yeah. You mentioned the slaughterhouse. Where was that? That's where they kill all the beef. Down in St. Canale. In Araby. In Araby. Way down there.
Yeah. Well, it's that way down. It's far enough, but it's... It's about the 1,600 blocks. About 1,600. 1,600 below Canale's there. It's about 1,600. 800, 1,700.
About Brother Canale is the... Oh, yeah.
